item.title: Artificial Intelligence and Posthumous Releases
item.description: When Does Musical Technology Become Unethical?When the news broke that the first Beatles song in decades to feature all four members would be released, the world was excited. Like millions of others, I tuned in on the 2nd November release day for the mellow ‘Now and Then.’ The song is fine, a decent Beatles track but one that fails to reach the incredible highs of their best works.
